title: Liverpool vs Brighton: a four-game clean-sheet streak faces Anfield
description: Kick-off, venue and time zones at a glance, then recent league form, head-to-head results and a seven-match team comparison.

sections.heading: Why watch
paragraphs: Brighton arrive after four consecutive league wins without conceding: Liverpool face a side whose recent results make this much more than a routine home fixture.

sections.heading: What the season comparison says
paragraphs: Brighton have scored 23 league goals to Liverpool’s nine over the same seven-match window. That is a large observed scoring gap, but the comparison is not adjusted for opposition, venue or chances created. Treat the per-game bars as a description of the season so far, not a prediction model.

sections.heading: Recent form, with the competition kept consistent
paragraphs: The five-game tables contain Premier League matches only. Liverpool’s three wins, one draw and one loss yield 60%; Brighton’s four wins and a draw yield 80%. Brighton’s latest four league results also total 15 goals scored and none conceded. Cup and European games are excluded from those rates.

sections.heading: A balanced recent league matchup
paragraphs: The four verified league meetings below split evenly: two wins each, or 50% per team. A cup meeting in the provider’s five-match list was excluded rather than silently mixed in. These games span different seasons; an even historical split does not mean the teams each have a 50% chance on Sunday.

sections.heading: The question that can decide the game
paragraphs: Watch whether Liverpool can make their attacks count before Brighton settle into the contest. Conversely, can the visitors sustain their recent defensive control against a different opponent? The first goal could change risk-taking, but the available totals do not identify either team’s pressing shape or starting formation.

sections.heading: Forecast and selection limits
paragraphs: No calibrated win-probability model, complete current injury list or confirmed starting line-up was verified for this article. We therefore avoid invented odds and a predicted score. The fixture table uses Europe/London: this Sunday is GMT, not BST. Recheck the official fixture before watching.
